documents.title: Information Asset Classification Policy
documents.summary: Sets out how Southern Cross University classifies information assets and the controls that apply to each classification level.

documents.title: Information Technology (IT) Security Policy
documents.summary: Establishes the University's information security obligations and the responsibilities of staff, contractors, and third parties.

documents.title: Information Technology - Third Party - Security Policy
documents.summary: Defines the security requirements that apply when engaging third parties to deliver or support University technology services.

documents.title: Information Technology Conditions of Use Policy
documents.summary: Defines acceptable use of University IT systems and networks for staff, students, and other authorised users.

documents.title: Backup and Recovery Guidelines
documents.summary: Sets requirements for backing up University data and recovering it after loss, corruption, or disaster. Covers storage selection, encryption, retention, and cloud backup strategies.

documents.title: Firewall Security Guidelines
documents.summary: Defines requirements for configuring and operating SCU firewalls, including rule configuration best practice and change procedures.

documents.title: Patch Management Guidelines
documents.summary: Defines how SCU identifies and remediates software vulnerabilities across operating systems, applications, and firmware. Covers risk response approach (accept, mitigate, transfer, avoid).

documents.title: Remote Access Guidelines
documents.summary: Sets requirements for securely connecting to SCU networks from off-campus. Covers access approval, approved solutions (VPN, SSL), encryption standards, and access limitations.

documents.title: Third-Party Security Guidelines
documents.summary: Practical guidance for business owners on assessing cyber security risk when engaging third-party service providers. Aligned to the Third-Party IT Security Policy.
